table_IIa.operation: Y = X W^T; X:[U,K], W:[N,K], Y:[U,N]

table_IIa.limit_interpretation: U->infinity is the asymptotic one-load reuse limit: Q_S and RI diverge while Q_R remains N*K*b_w. It is not a finite batch or a record with zero in-window writes.

selection_rules: Keep the six models in fixed order; no substitution or ranking.
Language backbone only; exclude vision/audio encoders.
For hybrid architectures select native full GQA, not linear Attention, Mamba or MLA.
Use full/global GQA where global and sliding-window attention coexist.
Preserve native heads and actual QK/V dimensions; do not force GQA-8.
Record actual layer topology; selected sublayer is not the entire model.
Residency, U and L are study scenarios, not claimed execution facts from model reports.
